rm(list=ls())
gc()

# Read in files
```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")
consensus <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Consensus_Precision", "Consensus_Recall", "Consensus_F1_Score")]
```

# Setup
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

consensus_color <- c("#5592D9")
```

# Useful functions
```{r}
rename_col <- function(df) {
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Recall$", colnames(df))] <- "Recall"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Precision$", colnames(df))] <- "Precision"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_F1_Score$", colnames(df))] <- "F1_Score"
  return(df)
}

as_numeric <- function(df) {
  df <- df[df$Reference %in% c("Pangenome", "Linear"), ]
  df$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df$F1_Score)
  df$Precision <- as.numeric(df$Precision)
  df$Recall <- as.numeric(df$Recall)
  return(df)
}

delta_diff <- function(data) {
  pan <- data[data$Reference == "Pangenome", ]
  lin  <- data[data$Reference == "Linear", ]
  
  merged <- merge(pan, lin, by = "Donor_ID", suffixes = c("_Pangenome", "_Linear"))
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Donor_ID       = merged$Donor_ID,
    Variant_Caller = "Consensus",
    Delta_Recall    = merged$Recall_Pangenome - merged$Recall_Linear,
    Delta_Precision = merged$Precision_Pangenome - merged$Precision_Linear,
    Delta_F1_Score  = merged$F1_Score_Pangenome - merged$F1_Score_Linear
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```

# Calculate delta difference
```{r}
consensus <- rename_col(consensus)
consensus <- as_numeric(consensus)
delta_consensus <- delta_diff(consensus)

consensus_long <- data.frame(
  Donor_ID = rep(delta_consensus$Donor_ID, times = 3),
  Variant_Caller = rep(delta_consensus$Variant_Caller, times = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("Delta_F1_Score", "Delta_Precision", "Delta_Recall"), 
               each = nrow(delta_consensus)),
  Value  = c(delta_consensus$Delta_F1_Score, 
             delta_consensus$Delta_Precision, 
             delta_consensus$Delta_Recall)
)
```


# Plot
```{r}
set.seed(1)
consensus_output <- ggplot(consensus_long, aes(Metric, Value, fill=Variant_Caller)) + 
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.5,      
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,   
    alpha = 0.2,                
    fill = "grey") +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", 
    width = 0.3, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = "solid", 
    color = "black", 
    size = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6, 
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    alpha = 1, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6) +
  labs(
    # title = plot_title, 
    x = element_blank(), 
    y = expression(paste(Delta, " Metric Percentage (%)"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Delta_F1_Score" = "F1 Score",
    "Delta_Precision" = "Precision",
    "Delta_Recall" = "Recall"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.4, 0.3))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-62, 50),
    breaks = seq(-100, 100, 20)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = consensus_color) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = "black",
    name = element_blank()) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1,
    size = 2,
    shape = 21,
    aes(color = Variant_Caller),
    fill = NA,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 22,
                                             size = 6,
                                             fill = consensus_color,
                                             color = "black")),
    fill = "none") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.75, 0.05),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5, y = Inf,
    label = "Pangenome - Linear",
    size = 6,
    color = "black",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2,
    family = "Helvetica"
  )

consensus_output
```

```{r}
ggsave("./plot/supp3_consensus_boxplot_delta_pangenome_linear.pdf", plot = consensus_output, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
